item.title: Italian mayors of historic Grimaldi sites gather at Monaco Embassy in Rome
item.description: Mayors from 46 Italian municipalities gathered at Monaco's Rome embassy last week to discuss plans for strengthening ties to their shared Grimaldi heritage.

item.title: Monaco police report moderate crime levels at annual New Year ceremony
item.description: Prince Albert II presided over the annual New Year ceremony of Monaco's Public Safety Department on Wednesday, where Director Eric Arella reviewed 2025's security performance and presented a generally positive assessment.

item.title: Monaco students dive into coral conservation with new AMPN and CSM partnership
item.description: “Each concrete experience sparks curiosity and shapes their desire to protect the environment.”

item.title: Monte Carlo Rally gets underway with spectacular official kick-off
item.description: The 94th Monte Carlo Rally departed from Monaco's Port Hercule on Thursday, with 66 crews heading into the Alps to face what competitors are calling exceptionally challenging conditions.

item.title: Monaco welcomes 170 new nationals at traditional Town Hall reception
item.description: Mayor Georges Marsan hosted the annual ceremony honouring those who acquired Monégasque nationality in 2025, as the Principality's national population reaches 9,961.

item.title: Monte Carlo Rally: road closures and parking restrictions
item.description: Major road closures and parking restrictions will affect Monaco during the Monte Carlo Rally on January 24th as the principality hosts a special stage around Monaco's F1 circuit.

item.title: Security measures for Saint Dévote celebration set in place
item.description: Monaco has set in place a series of security and traffic arrangements for Monday's annual Saint Dévote celebrations on January 26th.

item.title: Celebrate Australia Day with Monaco’s Australian Association
item.description: This Australia Day, Monaco’s expat community is invited to celebrate with the Principality’s official Australian Association — all while enjoying front-row views of the Sainte Dévote festivities.

item.title: Monaco chef tackles Mediterranean’s lion fish crisis through art and cuisine
item.description: Marius restaurant's Didier Rubiolo's solution is quite simple: if you can't beat them, eat them. The chef has developed recipes showcasing the fish's white, flaky flesh, which he describes as similar to grouper or snapper. "Small steps can produce great changes," he said.

item.title: Prince Albert II in Davos: Ocean protection is economic strategy, not charity
item.description: Prince Albert II argued that the question facing world leaders is no longer whether to act for the ocean, but how to act at the scale that the moment demands.
